name: Create a document from a template

elements.name: Inspect metric and inch part templates

steps.name: a document is open in the MCAD Software
template grouping by document type is enabled
the user presses Control+N
the new-document template chooser opens
templates are grouped by document type
the user selects the metric template folder
the user selects the standard metric part template
the template details identify a part with millimeter units
the user selects the English template folder
the user selects the standard inch part template
the template details identify a part with inch units

elements.name: Cancel the template chooser

steps.name: a document is open in the MCAD Software
the new-document template chooser is open
the user cancels the chooser
the chooser closes
the previously active document remains displayed

elements.name: Inspect the current session's initial template selection

steps.name: a part with an active sketch is displayed in the MCAD Software
the user presses Control+N
the Create New File chooser opens over the part

elements.name: Create a standard metric part

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the user selects the metric template folder
the user selects the standard metric part template
the user chooses Create
a new part document becomes active
its viewport contains no visible model geometry
its model browser displays an origin and an end-of-part marker
a new document tab is visible

elements.name: Create a standard metric assembly

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the user selects the metric template folder
the user selects the standard metric assembly template
the template details identify an assembly with millimeter units
the user chooses Create
a new assembly document becomes active
its viewport contains no visible components
its model browser shows representations, relationships and origin entries
the assembly ribbon offers commands to place and create components
a new document tab is visible

elements.name: Create a drawing from a sheet template

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
a drawing template with a border and title block is available
the user selects the drawing template
the user chooses its Use Template preview
the user chooses Create
a new drawing document becomes active
its viewport displays a sheet with a border and title block
the drawing browser lists the sheet and its border
the ribbon offers drawing view commands
a new document tab is visible

elements.name: Create a metric sheet-metal part

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the user selects the metric template folder
the user selects the metric sheet-metal part template
the template details identify a part with millimeter units
the user chooses Create
a new part document becomes active
its viewport contains no visible model geometry
the browser shows a folded model and its origin
the sheet-metal ribbon is active
a new document tab is visible

elements.name: Collapse and expand a template group

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the metric part template group is expanded
a sheet-metal part template is selected
the user collapses the part template group
its template tiles are hidden
the assembly and drawing groups remain visible
the selected template's details remain displayed
the user expands the part template group
its template tiles are visible again
the sheet-metal template remains selected

elements.name: Change template folders before selecting a new template

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the metric sheet-metal template is selected
its details show millimeter units
the user selects the English template folder
the gallery shows the English folder's templates
the details still identify the previously selected metric sheet-metal template
the user selects the inch sheet-metal template
the template details identify a part with inch units

elements.name: Create a presentation and cancel initial model insertion

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the user selects the metric presentation template
the user chooses Create
a new presentation document becomes active
an Insert dialog opens for an assembly file
the user cancels the Insert dialog
the presentation remains open with an empty viewport
the browser shows a scene
the workspace displays a storyboard timeline and snapshot views panel
the presentation ribbon offers Insert Model

elements.name: Display templates as details

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the selected template folder contains templates
the user opens the template display menu
the menu offers icon sizes, List, Details, and Grouped by Type
the user chooses Details
the template gallery displays rows with Name, Size, and Type columns
the template details pane remains visible

elements.name: Toggle template grouping by document type

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the metric template folder is selected
a standard metric part template's details are displayed
templates are grouped by type
the user clears Grouped by Type in the template display menu
the template gallery displays a flat collection without type group headings
the details pane continues to display the metric part template information
the user selects Grouped by Type in the template display menu
the gallery displays part, assembly and drawing group headings
the details pane continues to display the metric part template information

elements.name: Select an assembly template in list view

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the metric template folder is selected
templates are grouped by type
the user chooses List in the template display menu
the gallery displays compact template entries under type headings
the template details pane remains visible
the user selects the standard metric assembly template in the list
the details pane identifies an assembly with millimeter units
the user chooses Medium icons in the template display menu
the gallery displays medium-sized template icons
the details pane continues to identify the metric assembly template

elements.name: Navigate backward and forward through template folders

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the selected template folder is not the English folder
the user selects the English template folder
the user selects the metric template folder
the user chooses Back in the chooser navigation bar
the English folder is selected
the gallery displays its inch templates
the user chooses Forward in the chooser navigation bar
the metric folder is selected
the gallery displays its metric templates

elements.name: Reopen the chooser after canceling a selected template

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the metric folder and standard metric assembly template are selected
the user cancels the chooser
the user reopens the new-document chooser during the same session
the metric folder is selected
the standard metric assembly template is selected
its details identify an assembly with millimeter units

elements.name: Navigate home from a template folder

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the metric template folder is selected
the standard metric assembly template details are displayed
the template root has no templates directly in it
the user selects Home in the chooser navigation bar
the template root is selected in the folder tree
the gallery type sections contain no template entries
the metric assembly template details remain displayed
the user chooses Back in the chooser navigation bar
the metric template folder and its gallery are displayed again

elements.name: Change template icon size

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the metric folder is selected and templates are grouped by type
the standard metric assembly template details are displayed
the user chooses Extra large icons in the template display menu
the template gallery displays extra-large tiles
the metric assembly template details remain displayed
the user chooses Small icons in the template display menu
the template gallery displays small icons
the metric assembly template details remain displayed
the user chooses Medium icons in the template display menu
the template gallery displays medium-sized icons
the metric assembly template details remain displayed

elements.name: Create a part by double-clicking its template

steps.name: a part document is open in the MCAD Software
the new-document template chooser is open
the metric template folder is selected
the user double-clicks the standard metric part template
the chooser closes
a new part document becomes active
its viewport contains no visible model geometry
its model browser displays an origin and an end-of-part marker
a new document tab is visible

elements.name: Create a selected part template with Enter

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the metric template folder is selected
the user selects the standard metric part template
the user presses Enter
the chooser closes
a new empty part document becomes active
its model browser displays an origin and an end-of-part marker
a new document tab is visible

elements.name: Dismiss the template chooser with Escape

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the new-document template chooser is open
the user presses Escape
the chooser closes
the original part remains active
its viewport and browser are displayed
no new document tab is created

elements.name: Inspect projects from the template chooser

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
a project is active
a template is selected and its details are displayed
the user chooses Projects in the chooser
a Projects dialog opens above the chooser
it lists project names and locations
the active project is marked
the dialog displays a project settings tree
the user chooses Done without changing the project
the Projects dialog closes
the template chooser is displayed again
the previously selected template details remain displayed

elements.name: Reverse an ascending template size sort in Details view

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the metric template folder is selected
the gallery is grouped by template type and displayed in Details view
Size is the active sort with visible part templates ordered by increasing file size
the standard metric part template details are displayed
the user clicks the Size column header
the visible part templates are ordered by decreasing file size
the standard metric part template details remain displayed
the gallery remains grouped by template type

elements.name: Retain template sort order when reopening the chooser

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the metric gallery is grouped by template type in Details view
the visible part templates are sorted by decreasing file size
the user chooses Medium icons in the template display menu
the user cancels the chooser
the user reopens the chooser in the same session
the metric template folder and medium icon view are displayed
the user chooses Details in the template display menu
the visible part templates are ordered by decreasing file size
the Size column indicates descending order

elements.name: Create a part after navigating to an empty template root

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the standard metric part template is selected
the template root contains no direct template entries
the user chooses Home in the template chooser
the root is selected and its template groups are empty
the standard metric part template details remain displayed
the user chooses Create
the chooser closes
a new empty part document becomes active
its model browser displays an origin and an end-of-part marker
a new document tab is visible

elements.name: Enable creation by selecting a template

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
no template is selected
the selected template root has no direct template entries
the template details are blank
Create is disabled
the user selects the metric template folder
template tiles are displayed
Create remains disabled
the user selects the standard metric assembly template
its assembly details are displayed
Create is enabled

elements.name: Create the retained template after changing folders

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the standard metric assembly template is selected
the user selects the English template folder without selecting another template
the gallery displays the English folder templates
the details still identify the metric assembly template
the user chooses Create
the chooser closes
a new empty assembly document becomes active
its browser displays representations, relationships and origin entries
a new document tab is visible

elements.name: Cancel component selection for a drawing layout

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the new-document template chooser is open
an inch drawing template with a populated assembly layout preview is available
the user selects the inch drawing template
the chooser displays the template sheet and available layout previews
the user selects the populated assembly layout preview
the user chooses Create
the template chooser closes
a component-selection dialog opens for a drawing view
the dialog displays a document name field and a browse control
it offers OK and Cancel
the user cancels component selection
the component-selection dialog closes
the original part document remains active
no new drawing tab is displayed

elements.name: Create a populated drawing layout with a component that needs updating

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
a drawing template provides a populated layout with a parts list and a view

elements.name: Cancel browsing for a drawing-layout component

steps.name: a populated drawing layout is being created in the MCAD Software
the component-selection dialog displays a document name
the user chooses Browse beside the document name
a file-selection dialog opens above component selection
it displays a folder and file list, a file name field and a file-type filter
it displays a preview area and Open and Cancel controls
the user cancels the file-selection dialog
the component-selection dialog is displayed again
its previous document name remains displayed
the user cancels component selection
the original document remains active
no new drawing tab is displayed

elements.name: Browse to a different component for a populated drawing layout

steps.name: a populated drawing layout is being created in the MCAD Software
the component-selection dialog displays an initial component
the file-selection dialog can access the folder containing a different part file

elements.name: Display the observed drawing layout for the captured component

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the captured populated drawing layout and its component requiring an update are available

elements.name: Reverse the template name order in grouped Details view

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the new-document template chooser shows the metric folder in grouped Details view

elements.name: Navigate adjacent part templates with arrow keys

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the new-document chooser shows the metric folder grouped by type using Medium icons
the part group displays Sheet Metal (mm) immediately before Standard (DIN)

elements.name: Navigate to template group endpoints with Home and End

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the template chooser shows the metric folder grouped by type using Medium icons
the Part group begins with Sheet Metal (DIN) and ends with Standard (mm)

elements.name: Use horizontal arrows at Part template group boundaries

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the template chooser shows the metric folder grouped by type using Medium icons
the gallery is at its leftmost horizontal position

elements.name: Create from a selected template in a collapsed group

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the template chooser shows the metric folder grouped by type
Standard (mm) is selected in the expanded Part group

elements.name: Press Enter after moving the template folder highlight with Up

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the template chooser shows the metric folder and its grouped templates
the details pane identifies the selected Standard (mm) part template
the user clicks the Metric folder in the folder tree

elements.name: Select templates with the secondary mouse button

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the template chooser shows the English folder grouped by type using Medium icons
the Part group contains Standard (in) and Sheet Metal (in)
the user right-clicks the Standard (in) part template
Standard (in) is selected and its details show inch units
no context menu is visible
the user right-clicks the Sheet Metal (in) part template
Sheet Metal (in) is selected and its details show inch units
no context menu is visible
the user right-clicks empty space in the Part gallery
Sheet Metal (in) remains selected and its details remain displayed
no context menu is visible
the user presses Escape
the chooser closes and the original part remains active

elements.name: Click a folder highlighted by keyboard navigation

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the template chooser shows the metric folder and its grouped templates
the details pane identifies the selected Standard (mm) part template
the user clicks Metric in the folder tree and presses Up
English is highlighted in the tree
the metric gallery and Standard (mm) details remain visible
the user clicks the highlighted English folder
the gallery displays the English folder templates
the details pane still identifies Standard (mm) with millimeter units
the user cancels the chooser
the original part remains active
